name: Thinking About a New Shower? What to Consider First

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Deciding on a new shower replacement is a pretty big step, and you want to make sure you're thinking through all the right things before diving in. First off, consider your budget – not just for the unit itself, but for installation and any potential demolition or tiling work. It's smart to get a clear picture of all costs upfront. Next, think about the functionality you need. Do you want a simple, efficient shower, or are you dreaming of features like multiple spray heads, thermostatic controls, or even a built-in bench? The style and aesthetic are important too; make sure your new shower complements your bathroom's overall design. You'll also need to consider the type of shower – stand-alone, tub/shower combo, or a walk-in design, keeping in mind the space you have available and any accessibility needs. Don't forget about water pressure and plumbing compatibility; some newer fixtures might require updates to your existing pipes. Finally, think about durability and ease of cleaning; you want something that will last and won't be a nightmare to maintain. It might seem like a lot, but a well-planned shower replacement can really transform your bathroom and add value to your home.
